Running on:
- [ ] CPU
- [x] GPU

Interface: 
- [ ] C++
- [x] Python

# Reproduction instructions

Here the minimal piece of code to reproduce the issue:

```
import numpy as np
import faiss
import time
k = 10
d = 1536
nb = 30000000
nq = 1
np.random.seed(1234) 
xb = np.random.random((nb, d)).astype('float32')
xb[:, 0] += np.arange(nb) / 1000.
xq = np.random.random((nq, d)).astype('float32')
xq[:, 0] += np.arange(nq) / 1000.

index = faiss.IndexFlatL2(d)
co = faiss.GpuMultipleClonerOptions()
co.shard = True
co.useFloat16 = True
index = faiss.index_cpu_to_all_gpus(index, co, ngpu=4)
index.add(xb) ##### WHERE IT CRASHS
start_time = time.process_time()
D, I = index.search(xq, k)
print(time.process_time() - start_time, " seconds")
print(I)
```

When running this piece of code the line ```index.add()``` makes crash the machine without any error message, the machine just hangs and then restarts.
